mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconcile_log (course_id, redis_stock, db_stock, action) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{redisStock}, #{dbStock}, #{action})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.course_id, c.title AS course_title, r.redis_stock, r.db_stock, r.action, r.created_at FROM reconcile_log r JOIN course c ON c.id = r.course_id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
